brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.requirement: A three-storey tower (parts on three levels).
requirements.evidence: Pieces on level 0 (e.g. piece:0,0,0, piece:1,0,0, piece:0,1,0), level 1 (piece:0,0,1, piece:1,0,1) and level 2 (piece:0,0,2, piece:1,0,2), joined by snap connectors.

Two drawers on level 0: drawer:0#0,2#cut (half-s base at 0,2,0) and drawer:0#1,1#cut (half-n base at 1,1,0). Two drawer-frame notches also sit on level 0 at (-1,1) and (0,-1), but they have no drawers in them.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey.
requirements.evidence: Two open full-depth bins on level 2: bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,2~hex-bin-full, on full bases at (0,0,2) and (1,0,2).

requirements.requirement: Drawers on the bottom storey and bins on the top storey, on separate storeys.
requirements.evidence: Both drawers are at level 0 and both bins are at level 2; level 1 holds only supporting bases and snaps. check_build: meshClash clear, no rule errors, no loose-body warnings.

finish.summary: Built a three-storey tower. Bottom storey (level 0): a cluster of bases with two drawers (on half-s and half-n bases) plus two drawer-frame notches with no drawers in them. Middle storey (level 1): supporting bases. Top storey (level 2): two open full-depth bins on two bases. Joint bolts lock the bottom cluster. check_build reports meshClash clear and no errors; the only remaining note is informational (open cap faces).

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
